verdict.rationale: Google publishes a public plans page listing storage tiers (100GB, 2TB) and sharing options for up to 5 others, which covers per-plan storage quotas, but the evidence pack contains no explicit per-user dollar pricing figures nor any description of what happens when a user hits the storage cap (e.g., restrictions on new uploads/sync failures). missing for 10: explicit per-plan USD/user pricing figures, documentation of cap/overage behavior (what happens when storage is full).
